result.instructions: Tools for Workfeed, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Review next week's staffing and unassigned shifts by department."; "Compare staff availability and overlapping leave before changing the rota."; "Show daily labor costs and revenue for this department.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Workfeed data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run workfeed_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run workfeed_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run workfeed_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. workfeed_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: workfeed_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: Department names and IDs. GET /departments. Unpaginated vendor response, bounded to5000rows and2MiB here.

tools.name: workfeed_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: Roles and their department IDs. GET /roles. Unpaginated vendor response, bounded to5000rows and2MiB here.

tools.name: workfeed_list_employees
tools.title: List scheduling staff
tools.description: Scheduling/contact fields only; excludes national IDs, banking, tax, emergency contacts, wages, addresses and custom fields. GET /employees. Unpaginated vendor response, bounded to5000rows and2MiB here.

tools.name: workfeed_get_settings
tools.title: Get scheduling settings
tools.description: Pay-period and shift-break settings. GET /settings. Unpaginated vendor response, bounded to5000rows and2MiB here.

tools.name: workfeed_list_salary_supplements
tools.title: List salary supplements
tools.description: Read supplement definitions, not flex-hour supplements. Duration days are inclusive in company timezone. GET /salary-supplements. Unpaginated vendor response, bounded to5000rows and2MiB here.

tools.name: workfeed_list_shifts
tools.title: List shifts
tools.description: Read shifts whose start>=startFrom and start<startTo (not overlap). Maximum93days per request here. Optional role and department must agree. No vendor pagination parameter is invented.

tools.name: workfeed_list_leaves
tools.title: List overlapping leave
tools.description: Read any leave overlapping from/to, including leave beginning before the range. Max93days here. Free-text leave notes omitted. Repeated employeeIDs/typeIDs filters; includeDeleted defaults true upstream.

tools.name: workfeed_list_availabilities
tools.title: List availability
tools.description: Read contained records: start>=from AND end<to, max93days here. End exactly at to is excluded; allow an extra second beyond the last desired end. This differs from leave overlap.

employeeID.description: Opaque Workfeed ID from a preceding read; not a UUID.

tools.name: workfeed_list_department_days
tools.title: List stored department days
tools.description: Read stored daily notes, manual revenue, extra labor and targets; from inclusive/to exclusive company-zone days, max93days here. Array may include null for unstored days. Calculated labor totals use get_department_stats.

departmentID.description: Opaque Workfeed ID from a preceding read; not a UUID.

tools.name: workfeed_get_department_day
tools.title: Get a stored department day
tools.description: Read one stored daily record; a successful null means no data is stored for that day.

departmentID.description: Opaque Workfeed ID from a preceding read; not a UUID.

tools.name: workfeed_get_department_stats
tools.title: Get department labor and revenue
tools.description: Calculated per-day laborCost/revenue, with from/to inclusive company-zone days, at most31days. Prefer laborCost here: shift grossPay is0 for monthly-paid staff. laborPercentage null when revenue0 is not0%.

departmentID.description: Opaque Workfeed ID from a preceding read; not a UUID.

tools.name: workfeed_create_shift
tools.title: Create a confirmed shift
tools.description: Create one shift after the user approves its exact staff, role and times. confirm:true is mandatory. released:true publishes it and cannot be undone through this connector. employeeID:null creates an unassigned shift. No automatic retry; inspect before retrying an uncertain outcome.

tools.name: workfeed_update_shift
tools.title: Update a confirmed shift
tools.description: Update one shift after user review; confirm:true required. Pre-reads current shift, optionally rejects stale expectedUpdateTime, and never changes either original UTC calendar day. Vendor additionally enforces company-date rules. Published shifts cannot be unpublished. No deletes or automatic write retries; inspect uncertain outcomes.
